roles.name: CPU & GPU Profiling & Bottleneck Specialist
roles.perspective: Uses profiling to identify CPU vs GPU bound areas

roles.name: Memory Footprint & Leak Detection Specialist
roles.perspective: Finds memory leaks and high usage areas
roles.prompt_template: You are a Memory Footprint & Leak Detection Specialist. Find and fix high memory usage and leaks.

roles.specialty: Making content load and stream efficiently

roles.prompt_template: You are a Network Latency & Prediction Specialist. Make multiplayer feel responsive despite network delays.
